admin.closure.announce.description: Button that announces the closure of the service.

admin.closure.announce.title.description: Heading of the form that announces the closure of the service.

admin.closure.announce_failed.description: Error after announcing or changing the closure failed. {reason} is why.

admin.closure.announced.defaultMessage: 已发布关闭公告。用户现在可以看到通知。
admin.closure.announced.description: Status after the closure was announced.

admin.closure.announced_at.description: Label of when the closure was announced or its dates last changed.

admin.closure.cancel.description: Button that leaves a dialog of the closure screen without changing anything.

admin.closure.change.description: Button that changes the announcement of the closure.

admin.closure.change.title.description: Heading of the form that changes the dates and message of the announced closure.

admin.closure.changed.defaultMessage: 公告已更改，已通知用户。
admin.closure.changed.description: Status after the announcement of the closure was changed.

admin.closure.check.deletes.description: Label of the estimate of the deliveries of the closure.

admin.closure.check.deletes.value.defaultMessage: 约 {deletes} 条（{accounts} 个账号，{inboxes} 个收件箱）
admin.closure.check.deletes.value.description: Estimate of the closure's Delete deliveries. {deletes}, {accounts} and {inboxes} are numbers.

admin.closure.check.federation.defaultMessage: 无论联邦模式如何，删除都会发送出去，但已封禁的域名除外。关闭后，联邦请求将被拒绝。
admin.closure.check.federation.description: Note on how the closure treats the federation mode.

admin.closure.check.holds.defaultMessage: 处于保留冻结中的账号
admin.closure.check.holds.description: Label of the number of accounts under a retention hold.

admin.closure.check.holds.warning.defaultMessage: 丢弃已关闭服务器的数据前，请先使用 CLI 导出这些账号的记录。
admin.closure.check.holds.warning.description: Warning when accounts are under a retention hold.

admin.closure.check.migrations.description: Label of the number of account migrations that have not ended.

admin.closure.check.migrations.warning.defaultMessage: 请等迁移结束后再关闭；关闭会在迁移之后发送删除。
admin.closure.check.migrations.warning.description: Warning when account migrations have not ended.

admin.closure.check.subscriptions.defaultMessage: 仍在继续的支持者订阅
admin.closure.check.subscriptions.description: Label of the number of supporter subscriptions that closing cancels.

admin.closure.check.subscriptions.warnin.defaultMessage: 关闭会立即取消这些订阅且不退款。仍在处理中的付款除外，因为它尚未提供任何权益。
admin.closure.check.subscriptions.warnin.description: Warning when supporter subscriptions go on.

admin.closure.check.title.description: Heading of the check before the closing.

admin.closure.close.description: Button that opens the dialog that closes the server.

admin.closure.close.confirm.description: Verb of the dialog that closes the server.

admin.closure.close.confirm.description.defaultMessage: 此操作无法撤销。用户将只能登录并导出数据，{domain} 会向其他服务器发送所有本站账号的删除。要继续，请输入服务器的域名。
admin.closure.close.confirm.description.description: What closing does, in the dialog. {domain} is the server's domain.

admin.closure.close.confirm.title.description: Question of the dialog that closes the server.

admin.closure.close.description.defaultMessage: 关闭将结束服务：用户只能登录并导出数据，服务器会从其他服务器上删除所有本站账号。此操作无法撤销。请先查看它会结束哪些内容。
admin.closure.close.description.description: Explanation above the check in the section that closes the server.

admin.closure.close.domain.description: Label of the field where the administrator types the server's domain to confirm the closing.

admin.closure.close.domain.description.description: Hint of the domain field. {domain} is the server's domain.

admin.closure.close.domain.mismatch.description: Error when the typed text is not the server's domain.

admin.closure.close.not_yet.defaultMessage: 服务器可从 {date} 起关闭。
admin.closure.close.not_yet.description: Note when the closing date has not come. {date} is the closing date and time.

admin.closure.close.title.description: Heading of the section where the administrator checks and closes the server.

admin.closure.close_failed.description: Error in the dialog after closing failed. {reason} is why.

admin.closure.closed.defaultMessage: 服务器已关闭，现在开始投递。
admin.closure.closed.description: Status after the server was closed.

admin.closure.closed.title.description: Heading of the section that shows the schedule of the closed server.

admin.closure.closes_at.description: Label of the date and time when the server closes, in the form and in the list of facts. Shown in the administrator's time zone.

admin.closure.closes_at.description.defaultMessage: 使用你的时区。可以选择任意日期；服务器不会自动关闭，日期过后请在此处关闭。
admin.closure.closes_at.description.description: Hint of the closing date field.

admin.closure.closes_at.required.description: Error when the closing date is empty or not a date.

admin.closure.current.title.description: Heading of the section that shows the announced closure of the service.

admin.closure.description.defaultMessage: 公告此服务器的关闭时间，让用户可以导出数据并迁移账号。公告期间，服务器照常运行，所有用户都会看到通知。关闭无法撤销。
admin.closure.description.description: Explanation at the top of the service closure screen.

admin.closure.due.defaultMessage: 关闭日期已过。请查看下方的检查项并关闭服务器。
admin.closure.due.description: Note when the closing date of the announced closure has passed.

admin.closure.export_until.description: Label of the date and time until which the users may sign in and export their data after the closure.

admin.closure.export_until.before.defaultMessage: 导出截止时间不能早于关闭日期。
admin.closure.export_until.before.description: Error when the export deadline is before the closing date.

admin.closure.export_until.description.defaultMessage: 用户可以登录并导出数据的截止时间。留空则为关闭日期后 {days} 天。
admin.closure.export_until.description.description: Hint of the export deadline field. {days} is a number of days.

admin.closure.export_until.invalid.defaultMessage: 请输入日期和时间，或留空。
admin.closure.export_until.invalid.description: Error when the export deadline is not a date.

admin.closure.message.description: Label of the operators' message in the form and in the list of facts.

admin.closure.message.description.defaultMessage: 纯文本，显示在通知和关闭后的页面中。可选。
admin.closure.message.description.description: Hint of the operators' message field.

admin.closure.message.too_long.defaultMessage: 消息太长。最多使用 {max} 个字符。
admin.closure.message.too_long.description: Error when the operators' message is too long. {max} is the limit.

admin.closure.progress.accounts.description: Label of the number of local accounts whose Delete is recorded.

admin.closure.progress.completed.defaultMessage: 所有投递均已结束。现在可以停止服务器了。
admin.closure.progress.completed.description: Note after the closure's deliveries have all ended.

admin.closure.progress.dead.description: Label of the deliveries that used up their attempts.

admin.closure.progress.fanouts_pending.defaultMessage: 正在展开到收件箱的删除
admin.closure.progress.fanouts_pending.description: Label of the number of recorded Deletes whose inboxes are still being computed.

admin.closure.progress.meter.description: Label of the progress bar of the deliveries of the Deletes after the server closed: the deliveries that ended (delivered, refused, skipped or out of attempts).

admin.closure.progress.meter.value.description: Value of the progress bar of the deliveries after the server closed: how many of the recorded deliveries ended.

admin.closure.progress.none.description: Note when the progress of the deliveries is not known yet.

admin.closure.progress.pending.description: Label of the deliveries not attempted yet or failed and attempted again later.

admin.closure.progress.permanent_failure.description: Label of the deliveries refused for good.

admin.closure.progress.running.defaultMessage: 投递正在进行。请保持 worker 运行；停止 worker 会停止投递。此页面每隔几秒刷新一次。
admin.closure.progress.running.description: Note while the closure's deliveries go on.

admin.closure.progress.skipped.description: Label of the deliveries not sent because the domain was suspended or the server unavailable.

admin.closure.progress.succeeded.description: Label of the deliveries accepted by the inbox.

admin.closure.progress.title.description: Heading of the progress of the closure's Delete deliveries.

admin.closure.short_notice.defaultMessage: 这留给用户的时间不足 {days} 天，他们可能来不及导出数据和迁移账号。
admin.closure.short_notice.description: Warning when the closing date is less than the days of a short notice away. {days} is a number of days.

admin.closure.summary.defaultMessage: 公告此服务器的关闭，检查关闭会结束的内容，关闭服务器，并跟踪投递进度。
admin.closure.summary.description: Description of the service closure screen in the administration menu.

admin.closure.title.description: Title of the service closure screen in the administration and its menu entry.

admin.closure.withdraw.description: Button, and the verb of its dialog, that withdraws the announcement of the closure.

admin.closure.withdraw.description.defaultMessage: 通知将消失，注册和邀请恢复可用，并会告知用户服务器将继续运行。你之后可以再次发布关闭公告。
admin.closure.withdraw.description.description: What withdrawing the announcement of the closure does.

admin.closure.withdraw.title.description: Question of the dialog that withdraws the announcement of the closure.

admin.closure.withdraw_failed.description: Error in the dialog after withdrawing failed. {reason} is why.

admin.closure.withdrawn.defaultMessage: 公告已撤回。服务器照常运行。
admin.closure.withdrawn.description: Status after the announcement of the closure was withdrawn.
